data.name: Bonus Feats
data.description: The spire defender gains Combat Expertise and Dodge as bonus feats, even if he doesn't meet the prerequisites. The spire defender is not proficient with any kind of armor or shield. If he becomes proficient in light armor, he automatically gains the magus's ability to ignore the arcane spell failure chance of light armor.
